recommendation: Keep this external-repo audit for FHIR core. If PA later finalizes FHIR-53234 or related ChargeItemDefinition.instance restructuring, apply that in the admin-incubator source or whichever repository then owns ChargeItemDefinition rather than restoring retired core source.
issue_request: FHIR-22120 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request for R5 asking that ChargeItemDefinition.instance allow DeviceDefinition as an additional choice without removing Device; the accepted modification also added ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition.
initial_application: Commit b8b51c33e1319e14185cb4eeb1b80540b2fde501 added DeviceDefinition, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition targetProfile entries to source/chargeitemdefinition/structuredefinition-ChargeItemDefinition.xml when ChargeItemDefinition was still an active core source resource.
additional_context: ChargeItemDefinition is absent from the current source/fhir.ini [resources] list, current core narrative links ChargeItemDefinition to the HL7 admin-incubator IG, and commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 intentionally removed source/chargeitemdefinition from core. The current admin-incubator published StructureDefinition still lists Device, DeviceDefinition, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition as ChargeItemDefinition.instance targets. FHIR-34621 is a later Published same-element issue already audited on the combined branch, and FHIR-53234 is a later Triaged proposal to split definition-like targets into a separate property.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source was changed. The seed issue's requested core edit was applied historically, and current authoritative ChargeItemDefinition maintenance belongs outside this core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Later Published PA issue added HealthcareService to the same ChargeItemDefinition.instance target list after FHIR-22120 had added DeviceDefinition, ActivityDefinition, and PlanDefinition; it is already represented on the combined branch by commit 256360bb32b94b56cb78a24007d4a2eff3f6d7c4.

Later same-element issue proposes splitting definition-like targets out of ChargeItemDefinition.instance, but its Jira workflow status is Triaged and it was not treated as an Applied/Published reversal.
